description: This file implements the CategoryService interface in a Java Spring-based e-commerce application, providing operations related to category management such as creation, deletion, listing, and hierarchical management of product categories.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CategoryService interface, managing categories including creation, deletion, hierarchy, and retrieval in the context of a Spring application.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new category, setting its lineage and depth based on its parent.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns a count of products associated with specific categories within a store.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their codes.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their IDs.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category's details in a specific language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new category or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on their lineage string.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Gets categories matching a specific search engine URL.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a category by its SEO URL.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code, with overloads for store context.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Returns subcategories of a given category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories based on store and parent category.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Retrieves categories at a certain depth in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Finds categories by name within a store and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists categories for a particular store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category and manages cascading effects on products and subcategories.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a category in a specified language.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Associates a child category to a parent, adjusting lineage and depth accordingly.

search-terms: list categories by store and parent
